items._prefer: Where several records share a name, the one latest in the load order is kept, unless named here (name -> id). Steel Arrow: the game's own, not the Helgen quest's copy MQ101SteelArrow.

ParaIntro._note: WO-137 item 6: Paragliding in Skyrim starts from three placed triggers (Paragliding.esp:00802D, :008021, :009060) in the open world with no name of their own, so the board reader says only somewhere in Skyrim. Dave knows the spot: near Falkreath a man falls out of the sky, and his journal, Fredrick's Journal, moves it on. When the PC names the nearest place to each trigger, that replaces this and Bob checks they agree.

questNames._note: WO-133: what players call a quest that its records don't hold, by quest edid: {_source, names}. Search finds the quest by these words too.

questClasses._note: WO-136 ruling 3: a kind of job a board, a courier or a radiant dispatcher hands out, said once for the class, not per quest. By line id: {name, says, boards}. A quest of the class the start check hasn't traced is checked as a class, with this sentence; boards is the boards the records place, null until the PC's check reads them.

missives.name: Jobs from a board
missives.says: Missives: take a missive from the notice board in any hold's capital or a courier's request; each is a short delivery.

questRewards._note: WO-129 Part 6: what a quest's endings hand over that changes a run, hand-checked where the ending's own journal line doesn't say it. By edid: set replaces the reading of the endings; each row is kind (mount, house, follower, item, gold), the ending's stage and journal line, only when one ending gives it and another doesn't, and from and fromText: the stage whose text says it.
